description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::beta_distribution class, including serialization, degenerate cases, statistical validation, and implementation bounds. It also tests the internal distribution algorithms and stability of the distribution implementation.

classes.name: BetaDistributionInterfaceTest
classes.description: Template test class for beta distribution interface testing with different numeric types.

classes.name: BetaDistributionModel
classes.description: Model class for calculating mean, variance, and kurtosis of beta distribution based on shape parameters.

classes.name: BetaDistributionTest
classes.description: Parameterized test class for statistical validation and stability testing of beta distribution.

methods.name: SerializeTest
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of beta_distribution objects with various parameters.

methods.name: DegenerateCases
methods.description: Tests beta distribution behavior with extreme and boundary parameter values.

methods.name: SingleZTestOnMeanAndVariance
methods.description: Performs a statistical Z-test on the sample mean and variance of generated data.

methods.name: SingleChiSquaredTest
methods.description: Performs a chi-squared goodness-of-fit test for the beta distribution.

methods.name: TestSampleStatistics
methods.description: Runs multiple statistical tests to validate the sample distribution matches theoretical expectations.

methods.name: ParamName
methods.description: Generates a string identifier for test parameter pairs.

methods.name: StabilityTest
methods.description: Checks the stability and reproducibility of the beta distribution implementation with fixed internal state.
